translation: He should seek refuge in Allah.
He should renounce that which is causing his doubt.
I believe in Allah and His messengers.

arabic: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ.
transliteration: Huwal-awwalu wal'aakhiru waththaahiru walbaatinu, wa huwa bikulli shay'in 'aleem.
translation: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is Knower of all things.
